meta.source: Horry County Register of Deeds, AcclaimWeb deed index (https://acclaimweb.horrycounty.org/AcclaimWeb/search/SearchTypeDocType), Doc Type DEED (001), record dates 10/1/2024 to 9/30/2026, pulled week by week on 2026-10-29 (105 weekly searches, 59,170 deeds; the 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 part is 30,339 deeds, the same total as batch 2026-10-b). Parcel attributes from Horry County GIS parcels, MapServer layer 24 (https://www.horrycounty.org/parcelapp/rest/services/HorryCountyGISApp/MapServer/24/query), read 2026-10-29.
meta.definition: A flip here = the same parcel recorded on two priced deeds no more than 365 days apart (ATTOM's definition: two arm's-length sales of the same property within 12 months), where the second deed was recorded 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30. The purchase is the deed just before the resale among the kept deeds.
meta.kept_deed_filter: Consideration over $10,000; exactly one 11-digit parcel number; no 'DELINQUENT TAX', 'SHERIFF' or 'MASTER IN EQUITY' in a party name; no 'CORRECT' or 'RE-RECORD' in the memo; memo does not name several parcels, lots or tracts ('SEVERAL', 'PARCELS', 'TRACTS', 'LOTS', 'n UNITS'). 36,292 deeds of 59,170 kept.
meta.pair_exclusion_notes: 882 same-parcel pairs within 365 days. Removed: parcel not residential with a building (county LandUseCode not starting with 1, or MarketImprv 0): 317; builder name (pattern below) on the buyer or seller of the purchase deed or the seller of the resale: 153; both deeds recorded the same day: 21; parcel not in the county layer: 2; same name as grantor and grantee: 1; purchase price at or under 1.25 times the county's land value on a parcel with land value (likely a lot that became a new house): 44 (listed under 'excluded_likely_lot_to_new_house'). Left: 344.
meta.builder_pattern: HORTON|LENNAR|\bNVR\b|PULTE|MERITAGE|CLAYTON PROPERTIES|GREAT SOUTHERN HOMES|BEVERLY HOMES|STARLIGHT HOMES|BEAZER|ASHTON CHARLESTON|TOLL SOUTHEAST|H & H CONSTRUCTORS|RS PARKER|DRB GROUP|DREAM FINDERS|HOWELL HOMES|MILLROSE|LEWIS CONSTRUCTION|CHRIS MANNING|CAROLINA COTTAGE|HUNTER QUINN|BRADLEY JONES|SANDS BUILDING|OCEAN PALMS BUILDERS|INFINITY CUSTOM|ALMOND QUALITY|AG EHC|KL LB BUY|BUILDERS?\b|CONSTRUCTION|CONSTRUCTORS|HOMES (INC|LLC)|HOMES OF|HOME BUILDERS|DEVELOPMENT
meta.what_could_not_be_excluded: (1) Non-arm's-length sales over $10,000 (relatives, related companies): the county does not flag them. (2) A lot sold to a small builder or owner whose name does not match the pattern, bought above 1.25 times land value: some may remain. (3) The county land use code meanings are not published; 1xx with a building value is read as residential. (4) Condo-style units have no separate land value (no_land_value true), so the lot test cannot apply to them. (5) The county building value is the current one, so a house built after the purchase looks like an existing house. (6) Prices are the clerk-typed consideration; dates are recording dates.
meta.not_profit: gain = resale consideration minus purchase consideration. It is gross. It leaves out repairs, loan costs, taxes, insurance, utilities, both closings, the deed recording fee and commissions.

summary.denominator_filter: all deeds recorded 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 passing the kept-deed filter, on a parcel that is residential with a building, seller not matching the builder pattern: 10960

meta.fields: pin = county PIN; buy_bp/sell_bp = deed book/page (open at https://acclaimweb.horrycounty.org/AcclaimWeb/details/JumpToBookPage/1/<book>/<page>); buy_cons/sell_cons = CONSIDERATION ($); dates = record dates; days = days between record dates; gain = sell minus buy (gross); pct = gain / buy x 100; legal, td, landuse, county_land, county_bldg = county parcel layer; no_land_value = county land value 0 (condo-style); chain = first 8 letters of the purchase grantee match the resale grantor; resale_seller_company = resale grantor reads as a company. Party names are not recorded here.
meta.where: Added 2026-10-29 for the 'where' section: lat and lng are the average of the parcel polygon's vertices from the county parcel layer (MapServer layer 24, outSR 4326); zcta is the 2020 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Area at that point (Census geocoder, geographies/coordinates, Public_AR_Current, Current_Current); tax_district is the parcel's TaxDistrict field.
